question: What is a Master Batch?
answer: Master Batch is the participant list uploaded by organiser containing student details for training and certification.

question: What details are required in Master Batch?
answer:
Only these columns:
• First Name
• Last Name
• Email ID
• Gender

question: Should column headings be added in Master Batch?
answer: No. Column headings should NOT be added.

question: Should serial numbers be added?
answer: No. S.No. should NOT be added.

question: Can middle names or initials be used?
answer:
Yes, middle names can be clubbed with First name or last name.
For example, if the learner's name is Jessie Ranjitham Velusamy, Jessie as first name and Ranjitham Velusamy as Last name can be used.
Initials involved in the name Jessie R Velusamy can be used but not the entire name should be represented as J R V.

question: What format should be used for Master Batch upload?
answer: Master Batch must be uploaded in .csv (MS-DOS) format only.

question: How many students can be uploaded in one Master Batch?
answer: Maximum 500 students per Master Batch.

question: What if student count exceeds 500?
answer:
Split into multiple batches like:
• Chemistry1
• Chemistry2

question: Can two departments be combined in one Master Batch?
answer: No. One Master Batch should contain only one department. Make a batch department and year wise.

question: How much time does Master Batch validation take?
answer: Validation usually takes 48 hours after upload.

question: What are common Master Batch errors?
answer:
Common errors:
• Invalid email ID
• Duplicate email ID
• Existing student in another batch
• Wrong CSV format
• Blank fields
• Added title headers like Sr no. First name, last name, Email ID, Gender.

question: Can two batch year students be combined in one Master Batch?
answer: No. Batch year wise student data has to be separately created.

question: Can organiser edit Master Batch later?
answer:
Yes. Organiser can edit:
• Department
• Year
• Student name
• Email ID
• Gender

question: How can I request an online test?
answer:
Steps:
1. Login to portal
2. Under SoftwareTraining - Training & Payment Dashboard
3. Select New Test Request
4. Enter Batch Code
5. Select Invigilator
6. Select Date & Time
7. Submit request

question: Is STP mandatory before requesting test?
answer: Yes. STPs and Select Participant list must be completed before test request.

question: Who is an Invigilator?
answer: Invigilator is the authorised person who supervises the online assessment test.

question: Can Organiser and Invigilator be same person for the same batch?
answer: No. Organiser and Invigilator cannot be the same person for the same batch.

question: Should Invigilator register before test request?
answer: Yes. Invigilator must register before raising test request.

question: Who approves the test request?
answer:
Test request approval is done by:
1. Spoken Tutorial Training Manager
2. Invigilator

question: Is separate test request needed for C and C++?
answer: Yes. Separate test requests are required for C and C++.

question: How do students appear for test?
answer: Students login using their credentials under student dashboard and attempt the online assessment test during scheduled time.

question: What happens after passing the test?
answer: Students receive Completion Certificates.

question: How can students download certificates?
answer: Student can download certificates from their student dashboard under completed test tab.

question: Why is certificate not generated?
answer:
Possible reasons:
• Student failed test
• Attendance issue
• Participant list incomplete
• Incorrect email ID
• Test not properly approved
• Internet stability/connectivity issue
• Student missed in Masterbatch

question: What is the minimum score required to be eligible to receive Course completion Certificate?
answer: One must score at least 40% in the online assessment test.

question: What browser is recommended?
answer: Firefox and Chrome browser is recommended for workshop and test activities.

question: Can workshops be conducted offline?
answer: Yes. Downloaded tutorials can be used in offline mode.

question: What infrastructure is required?
answer:
Required:
• Computer lab
• Earphones/headphones
• Firefox / Chrome browser
• Download Audio Video Tutorial
• Installed software
• Internet (optional for offline workshops)

question: What if videos are not playing?
answer:
Try:
• Firefox / Chrome browser
• Re-downloading tutorials
• Checking audio settings
• Checking internet connection

question: What if students forget passwords?
answer: Students can use the Forgot Password option under student dashboard on the portal.

question: What if email ID is already used?
answer: A new email ID must be used because one email cannot exist in multiple colleges/departments/batches.

question: How can additional students be added later?
answer: Use "Add Student" option in existing Master Batch.

question: Can organiser edit STP after submission?
answer:
Yes. Organiser can edit:
• Semester start date
• Course
• Department
• Year
before marking Participant List.

question: What training types are available in STP?
answer:
Training Types:
• Outside lab hours
• Mapped in lab hours
• Unmapped in lab hours

question: What should organiser do after Master Batch verification?
answer:
Organiser should confirm whether all students received username and password emails for test conduction.
Should complete Step 2 – Semester Training Planner Form and Step 3 – Select Participant list.
